selectedOriginals.inspection: Full2019 small courtyard original inspected: real two-storey stone arcades on at least two sides, three body levels, stepped/curved gables, rows of rectangular roof dormers, red clay tile and modern diamond steel/ETFE canopy set above the roof ridges. Source caption says western courtyard; owner identifies this as Kleiner Schlosshof. Do not mistake it for the open Great Courtyard.

selectedOriginals.caption: Dresden Castle viewed from Zwinger
selectedOriginals.inspection: Full2008 western exterior panorama inspected: individual ochre/plaster wall bays over rusticated stone ground storey, two major pale stepped gables and smaller roof dormers, two projecting dark polygonal corner towers with open copper lanterns, central Hausmann octagonal drum/bulb/open lantern/tall needle and small oval roof lights. South wing and additional green-copper corner crowns; glass/ETFE canopy visible behind. Exterior window groups and brown frames differ from Great Courtyard decoration. Vegetation/flags/vehicles excluded.

additionalInspected.inspection: Full2019 Stallhof original inspected: genuine column-and-round-arch gallery with upper rectangular window strip; opposing low dark sgraffito wall and red roof with large plain gable. Georgenbau joins at the west end. Two freestanding bronze tournament columns. This is the connected stable-court wing, not the main Great Courtyard and not the adjacent Johanneum interior.

additionalInspected.inspection: Full2025 Schlossstrasse27 exterior entrance original inspected: actual deep double rectangular doorway with central pier, rusticated stone ground storey, tall paired upper brown-framed windows, drainpipes and projecting polygonal oriel with corbelled base. Street and visible threshold control local contact; furniture/signs/bicycle/interior excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Dresden: Großer Schloßhof,
additionalInspected.inspection: Full2025 Great Courtyard fountain original inspected: low curved stone basin, central round-backed original relief, three outlets, black/white ashlar illusion pattern and recessed tall brown/green barred windows with pale stone surrounds. Original abstract basin/back relief may suggest shape; sculpted faces and inscriptions are not copied.

additionalInspected.caption: Dresden: Großer Schloßhof,
additionalInspected.inspection: Full2025 Great Courtyard original inspected: black/white sgraffito facade, dark horizontal friezes and pale window frames, three body levels, four projecting polygonal stair turrets with bulbous pointed caps, red clay roof and stepped gabled intermediate wing. Temporary scaffolding/vehicles/visitors omitted. Painted historical figures and inscriptions are replaced with original abstract geometric pattern; post2025 conservation finish remains approximate.

additionalInspected.inspection: Full2008 Green Vault/west stone detail inspected: actual pierced stone balcony rail above deeply recessed arched grille windows, stone rustication, corbel/caryatid support rhythm and darker weathering. Original simplified scroll/medallion/corbel geometry, not exact human figures, heraldry or photo texture.

additionalInspected.caption: August Der Starke wall (Fürstenzug), Auguststrasse, Dresden, Germany
additionalInspected.inspection: Full2007 local original inspected: Langer Gang street wall, low rusticated base, large gold mural band, upper rectangular window strip, clay roof with small gables/dormers. At the Georgenbau end, steep red pavilion roof, green copper lantern, round green-capped corner turret and richly divided facade. Literal procession figures, lettering and heraldry are not copied; original abstract gold-band rhythm represents the decorative density.

sources.inspection: Current operator page read: total Hausmann tower height100.27m, visitor platform39m. Used as dimensional controls, not opening-hour/ticket advice.

Architect primary account read: double-curved steel grid carries transparent foil cushions above the historical small-court gables. Actual ETFE diamond dome, not a flat glazed roof or painted courtyard cap. Linked image could not be read; no drawing inspection claimed.
Operator description read: reconstructed Renaissance small courtyard with column arcades and gables under modern dome. Distinct from the open Great Courtyard.

State building owner18Dec2025 report read: conservation of west wing/stair tower/northwest chapel portal started2024 and was expected to finish spring2026. This does not confirm actual completion; model follows dated local references, omits temporary work and does not claim an exact October2026 conservation finish.

Owner75-page2020 construction document downloaded intact; relevant text and actual PDF pages3–6 floor plans plus18–19 dome pages inspected. Plans distinguish Great Court, covered Small Court, southern Wirtschaftshof, Georgenbau through-passage and Langer Gang. Dome rests above ridges; actual diamond grid and inflated foil cushions. Visitor/construction publication, not a complete measured building survey.
Operator account read: approximately100m gallery connects castle with former stables/Johanneum. Confirms Langer Gang is part of the palace museum and scope should retain this connected wing.

State castle operator account read: northern long gallery has22 round arches; exterior carries102m mural. Two tournament bronze columns and later separately used Johanneum distinguish the open court and its limits. Johanneum itself is excluded.

scope: Reconstructed castle exterior, main courtyards, Hausmann tower and connected wings; exclude the adjacent cathedral and Zwinger.
limitations: All117 candidate contacts reviewed, plus12 selected local Furstenzug sibling contacts; eight positive full originals individually inspected. Two2025 Cathedral views were read for discrimination and rejected as castle geometry. Unrelated museums, churches, theatres, gardens, airport, food, interiors, historical schemes and1980 ruin do not control this exterior.

Scope retains main castle with three native court voids (Great Courtyard, covered Small Courtyard and southern Wirtschaftshof), Hausmann tower, Georgenbau through-gateway, connecting stable-court wings and Langer Gang/22-arch gallery. Adjacent cathedral/covered church bridge, Zwinger, Taschenbergpalais, Johanneum and other neighbors excluded.

Current2025 local courtyard/entry images and2008–2019 exterior references control surviving architecture. The2025 conservation report gives a planned end date only; no exact present-day paint/conservation completion claim. Temporary scaffolding, signs, market stalls, cars, people and vegetation omitted.

Owner100.27m tower and39m platform,22 arcade spans and approximately100m gallery are dimensional controls. Native own footprints and skewed connected wings retained; other heights/roof forms/bay rhythm/ornament/thresholds are proportional interpretations.

Original restrained geometric sgraffito, relief and gold frieze density may approximate decorated surfaces; do not reproduce literal historical paintings, procession figures, heraldry, monograms or inscriptions. No facade photographs as textures.

Independent source terrain must be preserved and verified before model geometry. Geographic preview requires compatible ground; no terrain flattening/fitting, surveyed engineering or exact interior reconstruction.
